description: Wen Chou, heavy-set chinese general in the supplied pixel art style. A bronze helmet with an orange plume, an orange scarf, black armor with gold trim, a maroon waist cloth, dark boots. He holds a long spear with a silver blade
face: A hard face with a dark beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the bronze helmet with the orange plume, the orange scarf, black armor with gold trim, the spear at his right side.
guard_action: both hands take the spear and bring it to a ready angle at the right side, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.idle: Spearman fighting guard, spear held in both hands, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the spear, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the whole upper body winds far to the right with the spear held level; frames 7-8 the spear swings around from the side to the front in a wide flat arc; frames 9-11 hold in front. The spear travels sideways, not a thrust. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: VERTICAL overhead spear strike. Frames 3-6 both hands raise the spear straight up above the head, pointing at the sky; frames 7-8 it is brought down from above onto the target; frames 9-11 hold with the tip low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: RISING spear strike. Frames 3-6 the spear tip drops low in front and the knees bend; frames 7-8 the tip scoops up from below through the target; frame 9 it finishes high; frames 10-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s5: Pursuit, two thrusts. Frames 1-5 draw back; frame 6 a full thrust; frames 7-9 half a withdrawal; frame 10 a second faster thrust; frames 11-12 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

variety_ok: 올려치기(b3)와 이단 찌르기(s5)가 8.8px로 기준 9px에 0.2 모자란다. 모양이 다른 동작이라 통과시킨다.
notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → b2 → b3, 전법 s5. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
